description: This file contains the implementation of the PgSQL class which provides methods for interacting with a PostgreSQL database, including connecting, querying, escaping strings, and retrieving metadata like last inserted ID and connection status.

classes.name: PgSQL
classes.description: A class providing PostgreSQL database interaction functionalities such as connecting, querying, escaping strings, and retrieving information about the connection and last insert IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the PostgreSQL database with provided hostname, username, password, database, and port.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query and returns the result encapsulated in a stdClass object with rows, row, and num_rows properties.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in SQL queries.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the last inserted row.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is still active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection when the object is destroyed.
